description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Scaretiller and another artifact, targeting Scaretiller.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Fabled Passage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Fabled Passage enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Fabled Passage.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability from step 1, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Fabled Passage by tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search your library for a basic land, put it onto the battlefield tapped, and untap the land if you control four or more lands.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Toggo triggers, creating a Rock equipment token.
Repeat.
